purpose: Diagnostic case audit of the full outcome-blind functional-contract review; not a human gold set or an automatic admission ledger.

reviewer_qualified_sample_audit.selection_rule: Within each of the ten active Python CWE scopes, select the first three reviewer-qualified non-development task units by ascending content-addressed task_unit_id.
reviewer_qualified_sample_audit.clear_fault_reason: The source explicitly restricts usernames to letters, digits, and underscores, but the proposed contract omits that observable input constraint.
reviewer_qualified_sample_audit.interpretation: The sample is a stratified diagnostic, not a population precision estimate. It confirms that reviewer-qualified does not establish final functional or mechanism eligibility.
